dessin:
A territory map. A large irregular region outline drawn as a dash-dot ink boundary line, spanning from 4% to 96% of the width and from 22% to 79% of the height; inside, a winding blue river (#BFD5E6 fill, ink edge) and a few faint brown contour lines.
Near the top center (x 40-56%, y 24-36%): a small pale card containing two small standing human silhouettes side by side.
On the left (x 8-26%, y 40-54%): a pale card with one standing silhouette and three small conifer tree symbols (forestry companies).
On the right (x 72-90%, y 40-54%): a pale card with one standing silhouette and a small official building pictogram with columns and a pediment (government).
From the right edge of the left card, a thick blue horizontal line goes to the right and stops at about 48% of the width, ending on a small gold square marker with pale yellow fill.
Below the left card (x 6-32%, y 59-77%): three small software windows side by side, each a rectangle with a title bar and three tiny buttons, each with a different interior drawing: a map polygon, a table grid, a line chart.

elements.territoire: the dash-dot boundary outline of the territory with its river and contour lines
elements.fondateurs: the small card at the top with two human silhouettes
elements.entreprises: the card on the left with one silhouette and conifer trees
elements.gouvernement: the card on the right with one silhouette and the building with columns
elements.liaison: the thick blue horizontal line going right from the left card
elements.manque: the small gold square marker at the end of the blue line
elements.fenetres: the group of three small software windows below the left card
